title: File:Kandersteg from south west.jpg
claims: The image is a daylight view of Kandersteg from the south-west above the valley: the village and railway sit on a green floor, with conifer forest in front and rock peaks behind.

Commons describes the photograph as Kandersteg viewed from the south-west on the Steiler Almenalpweg, with coordinates 46.482294, 7.659208; it shows the checkpoint village environment, not race-day barriers, an aid station, course markings, a timing mat, start arch or finish line.
The author is Trldp; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2020-07-19 at 09:55:21; the original is 3,648 x 2,736 pixels and 3,584,362 bytes.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 286,131 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Trldp, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
